notes: Parts 41-45: 41 groups processed, 40 rows. Merged groups: "chinas qingtianzu" + "botshare" are the same 2026-11-13 strategic round (Qingtianzu/Qingtian Lease and Botshare are the same robot-rental company; the identity is inferred from matching date, business and round wording, not stated outright by a source), emitted once under group_key "botshare"; "xilect" + "metax and ubtechs robot" are the same RMB 500M angel round, emitted once under "xilect". Round-up expanded: "erie strategic ventures" yields two rows (Blitzy, HiddenLayer); both are undisclosed strategic investments by a corporate VC, and their HQ cities come from prior knowledge, not the article. Group "cibc innovation banking" is a nondilutive growth financing for PortX (Debt); "backswing ventures" is an investment in Vigilant Works. Not-funding rows: Ring, State Bank of Pakistan, Google Gemini 4 Hydrogen, NVIDIA commentary, and Worker.ai (launch plus DeltaGen acquisition; Ratmir Timashev is its sole backer with an undisclosed amount and no round was announced). Web lookups used: 18 of 25 (8 searches, 10 fetches, one of which returned 403): Sennder (tech.eu; EUR 73M equity reported as led by Scania, spelled "Scanai" in the tech.eu text, plus EUR 155M debt from Coface, EIB and Deutsche Bank), iPronics (UPV page; the Series B was first announced in early September 2026, so announced_date is 2026-09-02 and the November feed item is a resurfaced UPV news page), Alta (pulse2; USD 47.5M Series A, with a separate earlier USD 32.5M seed not emitted as a row because its date and investors are not confirmed; HQ not stated), DeepSeek (Kyunghyang and Yonhap via stockhub.kr; the round total is CNY 105.5B, about KRW 21.1 trillion, so the feed headline figure of 2.1 trillion won appears to drop a digit; announced_date is the date of the report on the round, whose original close date is not confirmed), Qvyon (BetaKit; USD 8M seed of which USD 2M is venture debt, round closed in April and was announced 2026-11-12), Worker.ai (Technical.ly), Botshare/Qingtianzu (36Kr newsflash), Tongxin Intelligence (runtimewire; seed and angel rounds, investors omitted because no verbatim span was retrieved). Wrongly resolved article URLs: Stoa resolved to an unrelated meditation app site, the MLQ.ai Xilect item to the MetaX homepage and the DeepSeek item to cdn.deepseek.com; for Stoa and DeepSeek source_urls carry the Google News feed link instead, and the Xilect row cites only the TechNode article. Froncort.AI: the article says grant recipients were announced on 15 September, so announced_date is 2026-09-15 rather than the 2026-11-14 article date. Unresolved: group "serial founder" has no company name in the headline and the article text was not available (pre-seed, so no lookup under the $15M rule); the row carries a placeholder company string and low confidence. HQ is unknown for Trina, Nagaris, Distribution Demon, QB MEN, Morsa, StitchStudio, Stoa and Alta. Currency conversions use about 1.16 USD/EUR, 0.15 USD/CNY, 89 INR/USD and 21 CZK/USD.
